title: A weighted sum of rays from the origin is integer multiplicity with mass measure Σ|m_e|·H¹⌞ray(e)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, C ∈ 𝒟_1(ℝ^P), F a finite set of unit vectors and m : ℝ^P → ℤ such that C(ω) = Σ_{e∈F} m(e)·∫_{(0,∞)} ω(te)(e) dt for every ω ∈ 𝒟¹(ℝ^P). Then C has an integer multiplicity representation R (IMRep univ 1 with R.Represents C) such that R.measure(A) = Σ_{e∈F} |m(e)|·ℒ¹({t > 0 : te ∈ A}) for every Borel set A ⊆ ℝ^P, i.e. μ_C = Σ_{e∈F} |m(e)|·H¹⌞ray(e) with ray(e) := {te : t > 0}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (F : Finset (Euclid P)), (∀ e ∈ F, ‖e‖ = 1) → ∀ m : Euclid P → ℤ, (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, C ω = ∑ e ∈ F, (m e : ℝ) * ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (t • e) (fun _ => e)) → ∃ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, R.Represents C ∧ ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → R.measure A = ∑ e ∈ F, ENNReal.ofReal |(m e : ℝ)| * volume (Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∩ (fun t : ℝ => t • e) ⁻¹' A)
